studies.title: Inspiration4 Civilian Spaceflight Multi-Omics and Physiological Atlas
studies.mission: Inspiration4 (Inaugural all-civilian orbital mission to 585 km)
assays: Telomere Length Terminal Restriction Fragment Analysis
findings: Rapid telomere elongation during spaceflight followed by shortening upon Earth return
Immune activation and cytokine storm signature (IL-6, TNF-alpha) peaking in early flight
Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) mitochondrial signatures indicating cellular stress
Transcriptomic reversion towards pre-flight baseline within 90 days post-landing

studies.title: NASA Spaceflight Standard Measures Cross-Mission Longitudinal Repository
assays: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer
Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) Orthostatic Testing
findings: Trabecular bone loss blunted to 0.7-0.9% per month with ARED heavy resistive protocol
Optic disc edema (SANS) observed in 16% of long-duration male crewmembers
Plasma volume contraction of 12-15% within 72 hours of microgravity insertion
Post-landing orthostatic intolerance mitigated by isotonic saline loading protocols

studies.title: NASA Twins Study: Longitudinal Multi-Omics Comparison Across One Year in Space
studies.mission: ISS One-Year Mission (340 days aboard ISS vs Ground Twin)
principal_investigators: NASA Twins Study Consortium (10 Specialized Research Teams)
findings: 93% of spaceflight-induced gene expression alterations normalized within 6 months post-landing
Persistent chromosomal inversions and translocations identified in lymphocyte populations
Subtle cognitive processing speed reduction observed after mission landing
Demonstrated feasibility of long-duration deep space exploration missions
